sections.heading: Decision
paragraphs: Use separate regional queues for ingestion and delivery. Apply worker concurrency limits per webhook endpoint. Persist accepted telemetry before creating downstream notification jobs.

sections.heading: Tradeoff
paragraphs: Regional queues simplify isolation and reduce the effect of slow endpoints. They add dashboard and deployment complexity because each region has separate queue depth and age metrics. The release checklist must cover Singapore and EU independently.
